name: Northmen
summary:
Northmen is a real-time strategy game with pause, set in the Viking Age from AD 793. The player leads a Norse war chief, a small band of warriors and eight settlers on a map of the real world. Gameplay combines raiding and besieging monasteries and towns, with options to sack, conquer, take captive or burn them, building settlements from a longhouse to a jarl's hall, and developing trade by road and sea.

The game includes 38 historical peoples, holy places of nine faiths, 24 wonders, diplomacy with pacts and vassals, and an Endgame mode based on Ragnarök. It is single-player, uses pixel-art graphics and supports 21 languages.
